## What changes

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. For UI changes, include screenshots from the actual DSH Host when available.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`

Record the DSH version, platform, and whether checks used a standalone preview, actual Web Host, or native Desktop. Mention any checks not performed.

## Data and compatibility

Describe any changes to saved notes, attachment handling, agent access, shortcuts, or public Host integrations. If there are none, remove this section.
